title: KDASO：知识-数据双驱动的责任判定任务自动化技能优化
summary: 针对LLM在责任判定任务中技能库易过时、技能描述与执行存在语义鸿沟、技能过多超出上下文预算等问题，提出KDASO方法，通过基于近期数据的邻域条件归纳、基于LLM轨迹分析的执行对齐精炼以及上下文预算感知路由，持续演化技能库。在网约车判定、法律责任认定和逻辑推理任务上显著优于现有基线，跨场景迁移提升8.96%。
summary_en: KDASO addresses stale skill libraries, semantic execution gaps, and context-budget overflow in LLM-based liability adjudication. It continuously evolves skills via neighborhood-conditioned induction from recent data, execution-aligned refinement using LLM trajectory analysis, and context-budgeted routing. It significantly outperforms general and domain-specific baselines on ride-hailing adjudication, legal liability determination, and logical reasoning, with 8.96% transfer gains.
